messages:
Priya Rao: Morning — quick coordination thread for today
Sam - Events: AV crew on-site at 15:30PT. Please be at the Green Room by 15:45 for mics.
Evan Li: I'll bring the presenter laptop. Heads-up: my laptop's USB-C hub is flaky, bringing my own HDMI cable.
Maya Gonzales: Can we shift the roadmap slot 10 minutes earlier? We need extra time for audience Qs.
Priya Rao: Fine to shift. Updated agenda: roadmap moves from 16:10 -> 16:00, Q&A starts at 16:30.
Chris (Infra): Streaming endpoint will be on the new ingress today (ingest-us-west-2-v2). If you see high packet loss, fallback to ingest-us-west-1.
AV-Bot: :warning: Detector: Roomb battery at 18% — swap pack before go-live.
Sam - Events: Noted, spare battery in kit.
Zoe - EngPD: During the roadmap section can leadership confirm timelines for model onboarding automation? I have follow-ups lined up.
ProductBot: Incoming poll: Which topic should go first in Q&A? 1) Dedicated SLAs 2) Optimize suggestions 3) Private deployment compliance
Priya Rao: Let's order as: Dedicated SLAs, Private compliance, Optimize suggestions.
Evan Li: Quick test — sharing screen and switching scenes in OBS causes a short audio blip. Is it safe to switch scenes live?
Sam - Events: Avoid mid-slide scene switches unless AV confirms smooth crossfade. Use single scene for slides + speaker audio.
AV-Bot: Quick command if browser audio drops:
```
# restart audio bridge
systemctl restart audio-bridge.service && logger "audio-bridge restarted by AV-Bot"
```
Chris (Infra): Reminder: recording retention set to 90 days by default. If Comms needs longer, request archive in #marketing.
Maya Gonzales: Comms needs 1-year retention for investor-facing talks — filing request now.
Priya Rao: For the live Q&A — use this thread to drop questions, we'll pull top-voted ones to ask the panel. Also use :thumbsup: reactions to vote.
Zoe - EngPD: Adding a written question: "How will routing policies prioritize cost vs latency for mixed workloads?"
Priya Rao: We'll tag that for Engineering leadership.
Evan Li: During the rehearsal the presenter mic auto-muted once — what triggers that?
Sam - Events: Auto-mute occurs if voice level < -40dB for 20s (power-saver). We'll disable that during the all-hands.
AV-Bot: :white_check_mark: Auto-mute disabled for scheduled event window 16:00-17:30 UTC.
ProductBot: Note: live captions enabled. Captions will be available in main stream player.
Maya Gonzales: If recording fails, can we at minimum capture the transcript and slides?
Chris (Infra): Yes. Fallback: if video upload fails, transcript + slides are atomically saved to /shared/all-hands/fallback/ and link posted.
Priya Rao: Great. Any last-minute accessibility checks?
Zoe - EngPD: Please ensure speaker slides have high contrast and font >= 18pt.
Sam - Events: Copy that. Also printing 2 hard copies of slides for the moderator.
Evan Li: I'm ready for tech check at 15:50.
Priya Rao: Thanks all — starting tech check in 5. Drop urgent issues here and don't DM. :rocket:
